title: Traffic Sign Detection System
description: Problem: Drivers and ADAS prototypes need fast, accurate road‑sign recognition in varied lighting. Role: Lead ML engineer — dataset prep, model training, web deployment. Stack: Python, YOLOv8, MobileNet, ResNet, Flask, OpenCV. Result: Real‑time detection at ~30 FPS with 92%+ mAP across 40+ sign classes, deployed as a live web demo.

title: Gemini Health AI Assistant
description: Problem: People struggle to interpret raw health metrics into actionable wellness advice. Role: Sole developer — prompt design, UX, Gemini integration. Stack: Python, Streamlit, Gemini Pro API. Result: Personalised wellness recommendations from BMI, vitals and natural‑language queries, used by 50+ beta testers.

title: Medical Chatbot (RAG)
description: Problem: Generic LLMs hallucinate on medical questions. Role: Built end‑to‑end RAG pipeline. Stack: Python, LangChain, Pinecone vector DB, Flask, HuggingFace embeddings. Result: Grounded answers from a 700+ page medical corpus with source citations and <2s response time.

title: FoodHub — Food Delivery Platform
description: Problem: Local restaurants needed an affordable end‑to‑end ordering platform. Role: Full‑stack lead — auth, checkout, order tracking, provider dashboard. Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, React, TailwindCSS. Result: Production‑ready platform handling concurrent orders with secure JWT auth and a real‑time tracking flow.

title: Vehicle Rental REST API
description: Problem: Rental businesses lacked a clean, documented backend for fleet operations. Role: Backend engineer — DI architecture, middleware, API design. Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, Swagger, React, TailwindCSS. Result: Industry‑grade API with dependency injection, full Swagger docs and JWT‑secured endpoints.

title: EduBridge — Learning Platform
description: Problem: Students needed a single hub for course content and progress tracking. Role: Full‑stack developer — auth, course module, progress dashboard. Stack: React, PHP/Laravel, MySQL, TailwindCSS. Result: Multi‑role learning platform with course enrolment, progress tracking and an admin panel.
